'''Shrimp''' is a type of fish that restores 3 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking [[raw shrimp]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], granting 30 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in [[burnt shrimp]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's [[Cooking]] level increases. Shrimp is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the [[Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)|Lumbridge Castle range]] with [[Cook's Assistant]] completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Shrimp are one of the fish required by [[Caleb]] in the quest [[Family Crest]].

[[Rick]] can make shrimps for the player in a [[player-owned house]].
